The four shape assertions and the 114-tensor count assertion all run before `save_file`, satisfying the "fail loudly before writing" requirement, and the output is the single file `out/T2/model.safetensors` (clause 6). `index_select` preserves the float32 dtype, and `.contiguous()` makes the slices safe to serialize.
